sections.title: Mental model — the frame that slides

blocks.md: **Don't rebuild each view. Slide the frame: one element enters right, one leaves left. Two operations instead of k.**

steps: For each slide: sum += a[r] · sum -= a[l] · l++ r++
Answer updated per position in O(1)

blocks.label: fixed-window skeleton
blocks.py:
window_sum = sum(a[:k])                  # honest first window
best = window_sum
for r in range(k, n):
    window_sum += a[r] - a[r-k]          # enter new, drop old
    best = max(best, window_sum)
